title: Q3
description:
Read: Lev 16:27, Exo 29:14, Exo 33:7-11

The sin offering is burned outside the camp. After the calf, the tent of meeting is pitched outside the camp, and everyone who seeks God goes out to it.

a) He suffered outside the gate, and the people are told to go out to Him, bearing his reproach. Which outside is the pattern, the place of the burned offering, the place where God met the mediator, or both, and what does each make the reproach?
